title: Purpose.
bodyText: The purpose of this chapter is to provide a contingency plan to be instituted by the insurance commissioner upon the unavailability of medical malpractice insurance in this State.
bodyHtml:
[§435C-1]  Purpose.  The purpose of this chapter is to provide a contingency plan to be instituted by the insurance commissioner upon the unavailability of medical malpractice insurance in this State. [L 1975, c 161, pt of §1]

 

Cross References

 

  Medical torts, see chapter 671.
